Priya —

Thanks for the clear summary and the checklist. Quick answers inline:
- Intake: please use the Partner Listings intake form here: https://partnerdash.google.com/listing-intake (partner-ops will follow up with the access link if your account isn't in the portal).
- Security: SOC 2 Type II report is fine for initial listing; for co-sell and certain customers we sometimes require an attestation letter from your auditor. If you have a SOC 2 PDF, please upload to the intake.
- Review window: once intake + attachments are in, typical listing review is ~7 business days; co-sell approval can take 7-14 business days depending on workload, but we can expedite for priority partners.

We will need 3 things from Redwood to prioritize the co-sell path: 1) completed intake + SOC 2 2) at least one customer reference with a short quote for the listing 3) HubSpot deal IDs for the opps you want prioritized.

I can do Wed Apr 21 at 10:00 AM PT. Partner Ops (cc) — can you add a calendar invite and confirm the intake link for Redwood?
